business: National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL) is India's leading securities depository that provides dematerialization services, enabling investors to hold and trade securities electronically through demat accounts. It offers a range of services including mutual fund dematerialization, corporate action processing, and support for depository participants, issuers, and custodians.
customers: Individual investors, mutual fund companies, stock brokers, issuers, custodians, foreign portfolio investors, and other depository participants.
